whatThisPluginAdds.text: Countdown adds a Layout Builder widget for a scheduled target using an IANA timezone and normalized UTC value. Its public output includes a fallback state and time-change announcements.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors set the target, timezone, labels, and optional call to action in Layout Builder, and visitors see the remaining time on the public page.

developers.text: Typed input and render boundaries normalize time handling and reject invalid timezone or unsafe call-to-action values before rendering.

teams.text: Campaign and event teams can publish a clear deadline without hand-calculating visitor-facing timezone differences.

troubleshooting.symptom: The target time or timezone is refused
troubleshooting.cause: The timezone is not an IANA name, or the target is not a full date and time with an offset
troubleshooting.check: Check the Timezone field against the IANA list and that a target date and time is set
troubleshooting.fix: Enter a timezone such as `Europe/London` and pick a target date and time

troubleshooting.symptom: The call to action is refused
troubleshooting.cause: The link is not a site path starting with `/` or a full `http://` or `https://` address
troubleshooting.check: Check the call-to-action link and that its label is 80 characters or fewer
troubleshooting.fix: Use a path such as `/offers` or a full web address
